lines.text: As Jesus left the temple, He told His disciples that not one stone there would be left on another.
While Jesus sat on the Mount of Sinai, the disciples came to Him privately and asked about the sign of His coming.
Jesus warned that no one should deceive them, because many would come in His name claiming to be the Christ.
Jesus said wars, famines and earthquakes were the beginning of a great harvest, and the end was still to come.
Jesus said the one who perseveres to the end will be saved, and the gospel will be preached in all the world.
